```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
df <- read_excel("input/Rampon_2000_mRNA_uniprot_mapped_v2_ena_ebi_added_19dec_by_name_search_2026_03.xlsx") 
```

```{r}
colnames(df)
str(df)
df %>% gt
```

```{r}
# for lit review table 
lit_review_RNA <- df %>%
  rename(Gene_name_old = Gene_name,
         Fold_change_old = Fold_Change) %>% 
  mutate(fold_no = as.numeric(if_else(fold_no == "NC", "0", fold_no))) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = 2000,
    Author = 'Rampon',
    Animal = 'Mice',
    Condition = paste0(Phase," - ", Duration),
    Region = 'Cortex',
    Whole = 'Yes',
    Exp_type = 'mRNA',
    Method = 'Microarray',
    Used_name = Gene_name_old,
    Mod = " ",
    Mod_type = " ",
    Gene_name = uniprot_gene, # genename from uniprot
    Comparison = 2, # 2 - EE vs SH
    In_EE = Direction,
    Fold_change = fold_no, # fold_no - numeric col with correct - sign! 
    Arrows = case_when( # dplyr case when, instead of ifelse
      fold_no > 2.5 ~ '+++',
      fold_no > 1 ~ '++',
      fold_no > .05 ~ '+',
      fold_no > -.05 ~ '=',
      fold_no > -1 ~ '-',
      fold_no > -2.5 ~ '--',
      fold_no <= -2.5 ~ '---',
      ),
    Significant = ifelse(Fold_change_old != "NC", 'yes', 'no'), 
    pvalue = " ", #no pvalues provided
    N_tested = '3', # seems to be 3 per time group per housing condition (pg 1)
    Stats_adj = ' ', 
    Note = notes,
    Full_name = uniprot_prot_name,
    Uniprot_rat_accession = uniprot_acc,
    Uniprot_entry_name = uniprot_entry,
    Uniprot_link = uniprot_link,
    Wikipedia_link = 	wiki_link,
    Curation_method = ...4, # note on curation method
    Class_group = Category, #Catgegory as provided in table/fig of paper
    Other_link = ebi_link, # ebi ena link
    Other_comments = 'misc shows combined gene_ensembl info from their df',
    misc = paste0(SYMBOL, '_', ENSEMBL)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Condition, desc(In_EE), pvalue, Fold_change)
```
